title: Storm Sorceress on Balcony
description: A fiery-haired woman in steampunk armor stands on a metal balcony overlooking a dystopian industrial city, holding a glowing magical staff in one hand while casting swirling blue and orange energy with the other. In the stormy sky above, a luminous phoenix flies amid dark clouds, lightning, and swirling vortexes as people flee across a bridge below.
